set.body: Add first-class participants.tsv table support to scalafim-bids. Scope: add participantsTable: Option[BidsTable] to BidsProject, load participants.tsv once in the JVM loader while preserving project.participants, expose generic JVM table readers such as readTable and readParticipantsTable, and add tests/docs. Acceptance: participant IDs still parse from participant_id; all participant columns remain available as BidsTable; missing participants.tsv behavior remains strict/lax per BidsLoadConfig; sbt bidsJVM/test bidsJS/test and sbt compileAll testAll pass.
set.title: BIDS participants table access
